search_space: All 24 nonzero Gaussian integers a+bi with a,b in {-2,-1,0,1,2}, and all 276 unordered pairs; exact tests checked positive collinearity (same normalized rotation) and unequal squared norms.
witness_description: z=1 and z=2: both give multiplication by 1, since 1/|1|=2/|2|=1, but |1|=1 and |2|=2.
refutation_explanation: The same rotation R cannot have denominator both 1 and 2. Thus the universal assertion over every nonzero representing z is inconsistent unless a normalization of z is imposed; none is present in the supplied claim or quote.
